verdicts.reason: Both break the original panel structure in the same way. The illustration is crammed into the right half and its pipes stick out above a blue box that starts partway down. The left blue edge strip covers only the lower half, and a large dead white band runs across the top. ENERGY USE almost touches the artwork. In A, 'YOUR EFFICIENT' wraps onto two lines and its arrow ornaments drift far to either side, but they still flank the text. In B, the arrows are stacked above and below the one-line kicker, which breaks the ornament, and the text is jammed against the left blue strip. That makes B slightly worse.
